purpose: Machine-readable concordance connecting Marillier's EPHE research programme, specific 005 notebook operations, and the 1906 Primitive Energetics abstraction without claiming line-by-line borrowing.

evidence_scale.B: strong conceptual/operational concordance with primary sources
evidence_scale.C: contextual or programme-continuity control; no direct attendance/borrowing claim

records.marillier_problem: Taboo as protection against supernatural danger; sacred/impure initially confused; interdiction not originally moral
records.notebook_operation: Separate violation of custom/taboo/ritual interdict from moral fault; test clan solidarity, exclusion and blood/contact as alternative determinants
records.caveat: Earlier EPHE programme; no claim that these exact report sentences were copied into 005

records.marillier_problem: Institutions, rites and legends can survive the beliefs that produced them
records.notebook_operation: Syncretism/historical layering: present ritual complexes may contain originally distinct motives; inherited practice may acquire new rationale
records.caveat: Methodological family resemblance becomes significant because of later direct Lovejoy participation in Marillier's programme

records.marillier_problem: Afterlife as continuation of earthly life/status rather than moral compensation; survivance not founded on moral conceptions
records.notebook_operation: Classify determinants of future-life destiny: naturalistic continuation/status, manner of death, ritual, social/community, then strictly moral desert
records.caveat: 005 also contains independent cases and later layers

records.marillier_problem: Critical examination of missionary-imported biblical traditions in American myths
records.notebook_operation: Chronology/provenance test of ethnographic testimony; missionary contact treated as possible contamination of moralized eschatology
records.caveat: No proof Lovejoy learned this procedure only from Marillier

records.marillier_problem: Distinguish religious-union rites from magical purification/preservation and fecundative rites
records.notebook_operation: Decompose apparently unitary ceremonies by function/mechanism rather than outward form
records.caveat: Marriage material is contextual; the notebook applies the operator mainly to sacrifice

records.marillier_problem: Human sacrifice and ritual anthropophagy classified into funerary, expiatory, anthropophagic and magical types
records.notebook_operation: Separate funerary provision, propitiation, expiation, magic, cannibalism and communion; reject outward form as sufficient classification

records.marillier_problem: Conference 1: survivance/justice and refutation of Steinmetz; Conference 2: human sacrifice/ritual anthropophagy, including expiatory, funerary, anthropophagic, magical, agrarian and fecundative mechanisms
records.notebook_operation: Two principal 005 blocks reproduce the two conference problem families and transform them into determinant/mechanism-first classification
records.caveat: Report proves Lovejoy was an active auditor, not the exact content of his oral interventions or every notebook entry

records.marillier_problem: Agrarian sacrifice; magical/fecundative power of blood; expiation/expulsion of evils; Frazer criticism; amoral eschatology; Christian interpolations
records.notebook_operation: Blood/body parts as life-giving, curative, protective, transferable power; agricultural blood/life transfer; quasi-mechanical magical efficacy
records.caveat: Lovejoy is not listed among active auditors in 1899-1900

records.marillier_problem: Religion: magical sacrifice releases blood/life force; mechanical constraint distinguished from psychological/moral exchange; common dispersed mana/force
records.notebook_operation: Direct action on natural forces; intrinsic efficacy versus indwelling spirit; transferable life/power; quasi-mechanical magical rather than sacramental explanation
records.caveat: Cosmovisions is a searchable reproduction/locator; publication-grade quotation requires Grande Encyclopedie XXVIII facsimile collation

records.notebook_operation: Repeated discrimination between personal agency and intrinsic/direct/transferable efficacy is abstracted as impersonal, quasi-mechanical, communicable primitive energetics
records.caveat: High continuity of operation/concept; insufficient evidence that 005 is a literal article draft
